aiSimulationNote: Simulation mode. Generation and revision use sample responses. These settings do not enable live AI yet.
aiLiveNote: AI connection settings for generation and revision through the backend.
aiServerKeyPrivacy: The key is sent only to the backend for secure server storage. Saved keys are never returned to this form.
aiServerKeyPresent: API key configured on the server.
aiEndpointHint: HTTPS base URL for the provider’s API.
aiKeyPrivacy: The key stays in memory for this tab only and is cleared on refresh. Only provider, model, and URL are saved locally. Secure server storage comes with the backend.
aiKeyPresent: API key available for this tab until refresh.
aiUnsaved: Unsaved changes. Save before testing. Changing provider or URL requires entering the key again.
aiSaved: AI settings saved. Generation and revision still use simulation.
aiTestSimulated: Simulation passed. Settings are valid locally; the provider has not verified the key or model. No API request was sent.
aiKeyRequired: Enter and save an API key before testing.
aiInvalidSettings: Check the model, HTTPS URL, and API key.
aiModelInvalid: Enter a model identifier without spaces (up to 128 characters).
aiEndpointInvalid: Enter an HTTPS URL without credentials, query parameters, or a fragment.
title: Document name
ledgerDescription: From early notes to a specification you can review.
deleteWarning: This document and its version history will be deleted from this browser. Type the document name to continue.
emptyDescription: Start with a system description, meeting notes, or an interview transcript.
reviewHint: Read, clarify, and approve each requirement.
newDescription: Describe the system you want to build. Rough notes are enough to begin.
guidanceTitle: A useful draft starts with context.
guidance1Text: Actors, responsibilities, and who may access the data.
guidance2Text: Workflows, exceptions, deadlines, and any known numbers.
guidance3Text: Interview transcripts, meeting minutes, or terms of reference.
contextPlaceholder: Example: Bina Sehat Hospital needs a system for patient registration, medical records, and pharmacy. There are seven user roles…
dropzone: Drop files here, or browse files
fileHelp: PDF or TXT, up to 10 MB per file
inputNote: Your description and files are merged into one context. You still need to review the draft.
finalizeDescription: Every section will be locked. The document is ready to compile and download. Verify the requirements with stakeholders first.
generationError: Drafting was interrupted. Completed chapters are saved. Try again from this stage.
qualityDescription: Simulated checks help identify phrases that need measurable criteria.
retrievalNote: Simulated reference excerpts. These are not live search results.
noHistory: History is created when changes are applied or the document is finalized.
revisionDescription: Only the selected section changes. Review the proposal before applying it.
example2: Clarify the payment use case to support QRIS
example3: Add an audit trail for authentication
revisionStage: Refining the query, retrieving context, and rewriting this section…
revisionError: The revision did not finish. Your instruction is preserved. Try sending it again.
diffDescription: Nothing is saved until you apply the proposal.
exportDescription: Your draft is finalized. Download it to share and review together.
exportNote: Word includes a cover, contents field, numbered chapters, and tables. Update the contents field when you first open it.
pdfNote: PDF uses the browser print dialog. Select Save as PDF as the destination.
researchInvite: How was your experience? Complete the SUS questionnaire after using the app.
evaluationDescription: Draft structure, expert assessment, and usability in one research record.
sampleData: Includes 12 sample simulation logs. New generations add actual simulation records.
blindNote: The document source is hidden until your assessment is submitted.
susDescription: Answer ten statements based on your experience using the application.
susBenchmark: Comparison benchmark: 68. SUS measures perceived usability, not a success percentage.
susFootnote: Interpretation: Bangor, Kortum & Miller (2009); Sauro (2011). The researcher should validate this translation.
rougeNote: ROUGE measures word overlap between a draft and its reference document. Read it alongside expert assessments.
importError: Invalid results format. Use the example JSON schema.
sheetDescription: Show the manuscript on light paper in the dark workspace.
researchDescription: Show a SUS invitation after export and use blinded assessment labels.
dataDescription: Documents are stored in this browser on this device. Export a copy for safekeeping.
resetDescription: All projects, history, and evaluation answers will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
storageError: Browser storage is unavailable or full. Allow storage or free some space, then try again.
schemaError: Local data does not match this application version. Export available data, then reset storage.
notImplemented: The backend adapter is not implemented. Use mock mode. See docs/backend-roadmap.md.
configDescription: Set server credentials using .env.example or use NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_MODE=mock.
invalidFile: Unsupported file. Choose a PDF or TXT file.
fileTooLarge: The file exceeds 10 MB. Choose a smaller file.
cancelled: Drafting cancelled. Completed sections are saved.
aboutStandard: Structured to IEEE 830-1998. Content requires author validation.
